title: IPC refusals thrown instead of answered (#129)
notes: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/129 — projects:open refuses a remote screen's folder dialog by throwing, so the screen reads Electron's 'Error invoking remote method' wrapper. Return the refusal as a value.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #149: the folder dialog refusal is answered as a value instead of thrown, the screen's status bar says to type the path on the host, and the notice clears after a later successful open. Version 2.32.15.
